title: Solving Linear Equations
preview: Multi-step equations, equations with variables on both sides, distributive property, and rearranging formulas.
description: Students solve and verify multi-step linear equations from real-world setups, recognise when an equation has no solution or infinite solutions, and rearrange formulas to isolate any variable.

sections.label: 3-1 Multi-Step Linear Equations
sections.description: Solve equations involving combining like terms and the distributive property.

sections.label: 3-2 Variables on Both Sides
sections.description: Solve equations with variables on both sides; identify no-solution and infinite-solution cases.

sections.label: 3-3 Distributive Property in Word Problems
sections.description: Set up and solve word problems requiring the distributive property.

sections.label: 3-4 Rearranging Formulas (Literal Equations)
sections.description: Solve a formula for one of its variables.

source.name: Plug N Play
